stem.text: Stained onion cells undergoing mitosis were observed using a microscope.
Which row is correct for mitosis in plant cells?

A.text: centrioles visible; chromosomes pair up at the equator; two telomeres are visible on each chromatid; two nuclear membranes form

B.text: centromeres present; chromosomes align at the equator; chromosomes replicate to form chromatids; centrioles disappear

C.text: each chromosome is visible as two chromatids; centromeres attach to spindle fibres; chromatids separate and migrate to opposite poles; chromosomes decondense

D.text: spindle fibres formed by centrioles; centromeres attach to spindle fibres; chromatids are pulled apart by centrioles; spindle fibres form new nuclear membranes
